name: surgeons_knot
title: Surgeon's knot
about: A square knot with one more twist in its first half: the two ends are wound round each other twice, which holds while the second half is tied the other way on top. Shown loose, the two halves side by side: five crossings, then three the other way.

steps.caption: Two ends, coming towards each other.
Cross the first cord over the second, then under it and over it again: a half knot.
Wind it round once more: under the second cord and over it. This double twist is what makes it a surgeon's knot.
Now a half knot the other way: the first cord goes over the second again, then under it and over it. Pull all four ends.
